item.title: Megastar Aamir Khan to Play Pickleball with Fans and Emerging Talent in WPBL Pickler Contest
item.description: The World Pickleball League has announced the Pickler Contest, giving Mumbai-based pickleball players a chance to play alongside Aamir Khan at Jio World Garden on February 7, 2026.

item.title: Skål International India Announces Dates for Skål India National Congress 2026 in Coimbatore
item.description: Skål International India has announced the Skål India National Congress 2026, scheduled from August 12–14 at Le Méridien Coimbatore, bringing together tourism leaders from across India.

item.title: Samit Garg on Union Budget 2026–27: When India Finally Began Counting Creativity
item.description: Samit Garg talks about how the Union Budget 2026–27 formally acknowledges India’s creative and live experience economy as a measurable growth sector.

item.title: Sacred Sufi Evenings: When Devotion Finds a Stage at the Royal Opera House
item.description: In this interview, the Royal Opera House team discusses Sacred Sufi Evenings, presented in association with Avid Learning, featuring Aalam-e-Ishq and Ibaadat this February.

item.title: Tribes Communications Makes Strategic Investment in TRIOOH to Strengthen OOH and Tech-Led Capabilities
item.description: Tribes Communications has made a strategic investment in TRIOOH to enhance tech-driven, scalable out-of-home advertising solutions for brands.

item.title: Coca-Cola India Partners Magh Mela 2026 With Focus on Hydration, Livelihoods and Sustainability
item.description: Coca-Cola India strengthens its presence at Magh Mela 2026 with scaled hydration access, local livelihood creation, and community-first retail initiatives across Prayagraj.

item.title: BMW Group India Returns as Presenting Partner of India Art Fair 2026, Marking a Decade-long Cultural Commitment
item.description: BMW Group India returns as Presenting Partner of India Art Fair 2026, marking 10 years of partnership, with Afrah Shafiq’s art commission and the BMW Concept Speedtop showcased.

item.title: Sunburn Holi Weekend 2026 to Light Up India with KSHMR’s Five-City Tour
item.description: Sunburn Holi Weekend 2026 will see global EDM star KSHMR headline a high-energy five-city India tour this March, blending cinematic electronic music with festive Holi celebrations.

item.title: HRAWI Conducts FSSAI FoSTaC Food Safety Training Programme in Indore
item.description: HRAWI conducted FSSAI’s FoSTaC food safety training in Indore, equipping 21 hospitality professionals with practical insights on hygiene, sanitation, and safe food handling practices.

item.title: LogiMAT India 2026 Kicks Off in Mumbai, Focuses on Skill Development and Global Collaboration
item.description: LogiMAT India 2026 opened in Mumbai with strong global participation and a renewed focus on bridging the logistics talent gap through industry-led skilling, innovation, and international collaboration.
